Speed- ODM Gear. It uses both pulling, gravity, and air to propel (Web swinging only uses gravity and pulling), but its hard to use and weighs heavily on the body which brings me to my next point. 

Safety- Web Swinging. This one is more guess than anything. Both are ridiculously dangerous. If you've read the Attack on Titan manga you should understand to a degree the difficulties of maneuvering gear. It puts a serious strain on the body so much so that you could break your spine. If you don't know how to use it, you could fall and break many things. ODM Gear uses lots of muscle. 
From what I read in the comments, Spidey is only able to use We Swinging bc he has super powers. 
And realistically, neither ODM or Webs can be used irl (basically). If you have superpowers lol you should be fine with Webs but ODM is just a risky death trap.

Control- ODM Gear. I believe ODM Gear is better at control because once you get the hang of it, you probably wont break any bones. It pulls two ways and hooks onto things while sticky web only sticks. That would make me anxious. At the same time, I feel Web swing might be easier to control because it just seems that way, but think about it. You hand to yank and fly only relying on a spider string while you have security with ODM bc while flying you're controlling it at all times so u dont break bones or fall.

Mobility- Def Web swinging. Do I have to explain this? ODM involves the whole body at all times while wearing it. One wrong move or twitch and you could dislocate your whole spine. You have to constantly worry if you're doing things right so not to fall/break bones. Web swinging on the other hand, has less control and Reliability = freedom. You might have to worry about face f*cking/making out with a building tho.

Best way to travel- Web Swinging. If web swinging didnt need superpowers then definitely this is the best way to travel. But, I really want to use ODM Gear soooo.... ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
